title: Change of variables for Hausdorff integrals under a blow-up map
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝ^P an arbitrary set, x ∈ ℝ^P and r > 0, and let η_{x,r}(y) := r^{-1}(y − x) (SimonGMT blowUpMap x r). Then for every function f : ℝ^P → ℝ, ∫_{η_{x,r}(M)} f dH^n = r^{-n} ∫_M f(η_{x,r}(y)) dH^n(y). Here H^n = μHE[n], the integrals are Bochner integrals, and no measurability or integrability of M or f is assumed.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, ∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' M, f y ∂μHE[n] = r⁻¹ ^ n * ∫ y in M, f (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r y) ∂μHE[n]
